To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we proposed an attention based template adaptation algorithm for face recognition, and the proposed algorithm can produce results comparable to the current state of the art.

the attention based neural network can integrate the template features to a single fixed feature representation and the template adaptation module can improve the recognition performance by transferring the knowledge from the hold out dataset to test templates.
our proposed algorithm can improve the performance of face verification in the unconstrained environments by combining the attention mechanism and the transfer learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (1) The feature extractor module can be used to extract the feature of a template of variable length and can be used as a general feature extractor in the field of image and video processing; (2) The transfer module can be applied to transfer the knowledge from the source to the target template, and the one shot similarity can be applied to calculate the similarity between the test templates.

the following contributions: (1) We propose a novel feature extraction method based on the attention mechanism, which can integrate the features with different lengths to a single feature with the same length, which can save both memory resources and computational resources.

the following contributions: 1) we propose an attention-based neural network to generate the fixed length feature representation for the template of various lengths, 2) we propose a transfer module to improve the performance of face verification, 3) we demonstrate the performance of our proposed algorithm in the challenging face verification dataset, i.e. IJB A, 4) the code is available at https: //github.com/zhengxiao/ABTA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is a novel and effective approach for the problem of face verification.
our proposed method can achieve comparable results to state-of-the-art methods with a much lower computational cost and less memory consumption.
the proposed algorithm has achieved state of the art results on the challenging face datasets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new attention-based neural network for face recognition and apply it to the unconstrained face recognition problem.
we can get the state-of-the-art results on IJB A dataset by using a simple and compact feature extractor module and a transfer module.
we can achieve a rank-1 accuracy of 93. 1% and a rank-10 accuracy of 99. 3%, respectively, on IJB A.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed attention based template adaptation can be used to adapt templates to the test set and improve performance.
we show how to use the attention mechanism to extract the features and then transfer the knowledge of the hold out dataset to improve the performance.
we can improve the face recognition performance in the unconstrained environments by integrating attention mechanism with the template adaptation technique.
